blocks.text: Generate and Test algorithm ke do bare qadam hain:

items: Generate: is qadam mein algorithm masle ke mumkin hal banata hai. Yeh hal randomly (bina soche, kisi bhi tarteeb mein), systematically (tarteeb se) ya kisi heuristic (tajurbe se bana andaze ka rule) ki base par banaye ja sakte hain.

Test: hal banane ke baad algorithm use masle ki requirements ya constraints (hadon) par jaanchta hai. Agar hal tamam conditions (shartein) poori kare to use valid (sahi) mana jata hai. Agar nahi, to algorithm naya hal banata hai aur yahi process dohrata hai.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test algorithm ke basic qadam bataiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: 1) Ek mumkin hal banayein (generate). 2) Use tamam conditions par jaanchein (test). 3) Agar paas ho to usi hal par ruk jayein. 4) Warna naya hal bana kar phir jaanchein, jab tak hal na mile ya mumkin hal khatam na hon.

items: Do qadam: generate (randomly, systematically ya heuristic se) aur test (tamam constraints par); sahi hal milne tak chakkar.
